post.caption:
Dad prays with his eyes now. You skipped 3 prayers today. 🤍

Room 214, 5:10 p.m. Since the stroke, his right side doesn’t move. You’ve been here since 6 a.m. — no Fajr, no Dhuhr, no Asr. Then the adhan from the phone on his tray. His lips move. His eyes close, then lower. Ruku. Sujood. With his eyes.

“So do not weaken and do not grieve.” (3:139)

Tonight at Isha: pray standing. Thank Him for your legs.

captions: Room 214. 5:10 p.m. The monitor beeps. Steady.
Since the stroke, his right side doesn’t move.
Here since 6 a.m. No Fajr. No Dhuhr. No Asr.
Then the adhan, from the phone on his tray.
His lips move. His eyes close. Then lower.
You’re standing next to him on two healthy legs.
That night. His balcony at home. His prayer mat.
You stand. Because you still can.
Four rak’ahs of Isha. And a long du’a for him.
